baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنذِرْهُمْ, يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ, قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ, غَفْلَةٍ, لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The imperative warning opens an actionable interval: fear can awaken caution now, whereas the named day is the severe occurrence in which missed possibility becomes regret because the affair has finished while the addressees remain inattentive and unpersuaded.

activation_trace.role: Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the ayah's still-actionable alert.
A day as a severe event makes the time-word denote a decisive occurrence, not merely a date.
Grief over what has passed supplies the affect produced by a missed opportunity.
Completion and expiry close the interval in which response could alter the outcome.
Inattention outside wakeful vigilance explains why the warning's interval is wasted.
Refusal of heart-settling assent keeps the warning from becoming committed response.

changed_reading.before: A threat announces a future day of remorse.
changed_reading.after: The ayah is a last usable alert whose urgency comes from the contrast between present response-time and a future completion after which perception can yield only regret.

baseline_models.mechanism: The regret-word can also image removal of a cover and exposure without protection. Completion therefore reveals the affair precisely to people whose present condition is like an unmarked terrain: the concealed or unrecognized becomes bare when defense is no longer possible.

activation_trace.role: Removing a cover makes disclosure an internal image of the Day of regret.
Being bare of armor turns disclosure into defenseless exposure.
A road or ground without a mark gives heedlessness a spatial form: no sign is being read.
A cutting judgment fixes the exposure and removes further contest.

changed_reading.after: Hasrah also names an unveiling event: the unmarked present gives way to irreversible clarity, and remorse is the felt result of being exposed too late.

baseline_models.mechanism: The hasr field permits exhausted strength as well as regret. Joined to an affair that has run to completion, it presents the Day as exhaustion of remaining agency: not only is the outcome painful, there is no reserve with which to reopen it.

activation_trace.role: Spent strength and interrupted capacity give regret a depleted, actionless body.
Finished completion supplies the boundary beyond which depleted agency cannot act.
The affair or state is the whole situation brought to its terminal condition.
The warning marks the earlier moment when capacity has not yet been spent.

changed_reading.after: Regret is the experience of an affair whose possibilities and the subject's power to use them have both been exhausted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same decree-affair pair first appears as an already determined sign and mercy, then appears in a performative sequence in which an affair is decreed, spoken, and comes to be. The focus closure is therefore not merely a punitive verdict: it is an affair fully enacted into actuality, while regret belongs to the heedless relation to that actuality.

activation_trace.role: Completion anchors the focus as an affair that has reached its end.
Regret remains the recipients' response to what is now complete.
An effective, accomplished act gives the earlier decreed affair an enacted rather than merely announced quality.
The affair or state is the same object paired with decree before the focus.
A manifest sign shows that a decreed affair can disclose rather than only punish.
Merciful tenderness prevents decree itself from being equated with regret.
Effective execution begins the context's explicit decree-to-existence sequence.
The affair is what passes from determination into actuality.
Uttered speech supplies the middle operation between decree and occurrence.
Occurrence and presence in time complete the performative movement into realized being.

structural_cues: 19:21 has أَمْرًا مَّقْضِيًّا; 19:35 has قَضَىٰ أَمْرًا; 19:39 reverses the pair as قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ.
19:21 coordinates the decreed affair with sign and mercy, while 19:35 immediately expands decree through saying into being.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated pair and the saying-to-being sequence; I infer that the focus passive inherits enacted completion and that regret arises from the recipients' stance toward it. A live alternative is that each recurrence is local and the focus remains primarily judicial.

changed_reading.before: The matter is judicially decided and therefore causes regret.
changed_reading.after: The matter has been fully brought into actuality; decree can itself carry sign and mercy, while regret is generated by meeting its completed reality in heedlessness and non-assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah reverses present and future cognition: today there is manifest wandering, but on the day of arrival hearing and sight are acute. The focus then names that day as regret and adds that the affair is complete, so the tragedy is not permanent ignorance but accurate perception arriving after usable time.

activation_trace.role: Present inattention supplies the low-perception side of the temporal reversal.
Regret is what belatedly accurate perception feels when it recognizes the missed interval.
Completion makes the new acuity informationally exact but practically late.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies future cognitive uptake.
Inner sight supplies lucid recognition on the day of arrival.
The contrasted severe day and today establish the temporal hinge on which perception reverses.
Present deviation from direction specifies what heedlessness is doing now.
Manifest disclosure makes the present error paradoxically visible even before its occupants recognize it.

structural_cues: 19:38 contrasts يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا with الْيَوْمَ and is immediately followed by the focus's يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ.
The hearing and seeing exclamatives precede the focus clause وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future acuity, present manifest error, and immediate closure; I infer the arrow 'late recognition produces regret.' The alternative is that 19:38 only intensifies two independent states without defining the mechanism of hasrah.

changed_reading.before: The heedless never perceive the warning's truth.
changed_reading.after: They do perceive it with force, but only when arrival and completion have converted possible response into unusable knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A truth-claim is first subjected to sharp disputation; disagreement then distributes people into parties and covering denial; finally the great day is a witnessed presence. Against that progression, 'the affair is decided' is the exit of a contested claim from verbal rivalry into an event all parties must attend.

activation_trace.role: Cutting judgment ends the preceding field of dispute.
The affair is the contested state now fixed as an adjudicated reality.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the claim around which contest turns.
Sharp verbal disputation supplies the pre-settlement mode of engagement.
Each taking a different path turns verbal dispute into diverging positions.
Groups organized around opinions give disagreement a durable social body.
Covering the truth explains how a settled reality can remain denied in the present.
Presence with seeing converts a disputed proposition into an attended event.

structural_cues: 19:34 names a true saying 'in which they dispute'; 19:37 advances to اختلاف الأحزاب and مشهد; 19:39 closes with قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ.
The social plural of parties precedes the focus's plural object and repeated وَهُمْ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth, dispute, factional divergence, and witnessed presence; I infer a movement from argument to compulsory settlement. The alternative is that الْأَمْرُ has a wider referent than the immediately preceding dispute.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified cosmic affair reaches judgment.
changed_reading.after: A claim that can presently be debated and socially partitioned becomes witnessed reality, leaving former disputants regret but no remaining forum for revision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier refuge and self-protection show fear functioning constructively, and the decreed sign is explicitly joined to mercy. Since the warning branch frightens in order to awaken caution, the focus imperative can be carried as a protective opening before closure, not only as menace.

activation_trace.role: Fear that awakens caution makes warning an intervention designed to produce protective response.
Seeking refuge supplies the action by which perceived danger can still be answered.
Repelling harm through protection gives awakened caution a concrete function.
Merciful tenderness places a protective quality inside the context's decreed action.

structural_cues: 19:18 responds to perceived danger with refuge and taqwa; 19:21 calls the sign a mercy; 19:39 commands warning before completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge, protection, mercy, and warning-as-caution; I infer that the warning offers a protective response-window. The alternative is that the earlier protective scene is local to Mary and does not color the later imperative.

changed_reading.before: The warning primarily threatens the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The warning is also mercy in anticipatory form: it introduces fear while fear can still become refuge, vigilance, and changed conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three repeated days of birth, death, and being raised alive are covered by safety, while the focus day is marked by regret. This prevents 'day' from carrying one uniform atmosphere: the temporal station exposes a relation already formed, yielding peace in one case and regret in another.

activation_trace.role: The severe event supplies the common temporal station whose experienced condition can differ.
Regret names one relation-specific condition on that station.
Repeated temporal durations connect birth, death, and rising as three boundary moments.
Safety from harm supplies a condition opposite to regret across those boundary days.
Rousing the still from rest identifies resurrection as one of the compared day-events.

structural_cues: 19:33 repeats يَوْمَ three times under one السلام predicate; 19:39 repeats يَوْمَ with الحسرة.
Both passages coordinate day-language with death or completed worldly agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting predicates over repeated day-language; I infer differentiated conditions at a shared boundary rather than a uniformly dreadful day. The alternative is that 19:33 is a personal formula with no distributive implication.

changed_reading.before: The Day itself is intrinsically and uniformly a day of regret.
changed_reading.after: The Day manifests differentiated conditions: regret characterizes the heedless nonbelievers addressed here, while the same boundary-day pattern can be borne under peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The narrative stages an earlier crisis in which death and erasure are wished for, grief is explicitly checked, and bodily action still brings gathered fruit. That sequence distinguishes sorrow inside an open action-window from hasrah after completion: grief can still be answered, but regret names the pain of no remaining intervention.

activation_trace.role: Lament over what has passed supplies the irreversible form of sorrow.
Finished completion distinguishes hasrah from distress while action remains possible.
Loss of life supplies the wished-for escape at the earlier crisis.
A forgotten, discarded thing gives the crisis the desire for total social erasure.
Roughness of soul through grief names pain that is directly addressed before closure.
Shaking something into motion supplies a still-available bodily intervention.
Taking gathered fruit supplies the result available on the open side of completion.

structural_cues: 19:23 moves from wishing death and oblivion to 19:24's prohibition of grief and 19:25's imperative action with a result.
19:39 couples its sorrow-word directly to the completed affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crisis, addressed grief, commanded action, provision, and later completion; I infer that actionability distinguishes huzn from focus hasrah. The alternative is that the earlier rescue sequence is too local to define the later affective contrast.

changed_reading.before: Hasrah is simply a stronger synonym for grief.
changed_reading.after: Hasrah is grief temporally transformed by closure: the earlier narrative shows pain that can still receive direction and provision, whereas focus regret has lost that action-window.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves through a literal barrier, epistemic covering of truth, and finally manifest disclosure. This ordered material-to-cognitive sequence activates the focus hasr branch of removing a cover: regret is generated when layered concealments collapse into clarity.

activation_trace.role: Removing a cover supplies the focus's terminal unveiling operation.
Present inattention is the cognitive condition maintained beneath the coverings.
A screening barrier supplies the context's literal starting image of concealment.
Covering the truth transfers concealment from spatial barrier to epistemic refusal.
Manifest emergence supplies the endpoint at which what was covered stands exposed.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from حِجَابًا in 19:17 through كَفَرُوا in 19:37 to مُبِينٍ in 19:38, immediately before يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal barrier, truth-covering, and manifestation; I infer a shared cover-to-disclosure mechanism that activates hasr as uncovering. The alternative is that these are independent local images whose sequence should not be unified.

changed_reading.before: The Day adds emotional remorse to prior unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The Day collapses physical, social, and cognitive coverings; remorse is the affect of suddenly standing exposed to the reality those coverings had kept unrecognized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies a straight, upright road, present manifest wandering, and eventual return. Activated by heedlessness as terrain without a mark, the warning becomes a route-marker placed before compulsory return: it makes direction legible while deviation can still be corrected.

activation_trace.role: An unmarked road gives heedlessness the spatial condition that requires a marker.
An alert that awakens caution functions as the marker inserted into that unmarked condition.
The straight road supplies the available direction before closure.
Uprightness and alignment specify the road's corrective orientation.
Deviation from direction describes the addressees' present movement.
Clarifying meaning by a sign gives the warning its route-marking function.
Return supplies the unavoidable destination toward which both alignment and wandering move.

structural_cues: 19:36 names the straight path, 19:38 names manifest wandering, 19:39 commands warning, and 19:40 states return.
The focus's warning stands between diagnosed deviation and the coda of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, uprightness, wandering, clarification, and return; I supply the arrow that warning operates as a road-sign. The alternative is a non-spatial moral contrast with no route mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Heedlessness is a static mental defect addressed by an alarm.
changed_reading.after: Heedlessness is unmarked movement on the wrong route, and warning is a directional sign placed before every route terminates in return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate coda describes inheritance of the earth and everyone upon it, followed by return. This gives completion a transfer structure: the closed affair does not merely stop events but ends provisional tenure, reverts possession, and returns occupants to the true endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Expiry and completion supply the end of provisional tenure.
Security and trust expose the false stability implied by acting as though present possession cannot revert.
Transfer from a predecessor to an inheritor supplies completion with a succession structure.
Taking possession without bargain or effort emphasizes reversion rather than negotiated exchange.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the whole domain whose tenure ends.
Return and restoration supply the personal movement accompanying the transfer of domain.

structural_cues: 19:40 immediately follows قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ with نَرِثُ الْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا and وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ.
The coda coordinates transfer of domain and return of its occupants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies completion followed immediately by inheritance and return; I infer that the latter specifies a reversion mechanism within the former. The alternative is that 19:40 is a broad coda rather than an explanation of الْأَمْرُ.

changed_reading.before: The completed affair is chiefly termination or verdict.
changed_reading.after: Completion is also reversion: temporary claims over earth, place, and self expire, possession passes, and the occupants are returned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates two distinct branches of ن ذ ر and reads the context's routing of speech as an analogy for the focus warning. It remains anchored in the exact warning root plus the vow, silence, gesture, and renewed speech sequence; downstream prose should present it as a structural experiment, not as lexical equivalence between warning and vow.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَنذِرْهُمْ as the warning branch of ن ذ ر

activation_trace.role: Warning that awakens caution is the focus speech-act to which the context sequence is attached.
Self-imposed obligation activates a distinct branch of the same root and initiates controlled silence.
Restraint of the tongue supplies the literal withholding of ordinary speech.
Intelligible speech between parties names what the vow suspends.
Gesture and sensory indication reroute communication while speech is withheld.
Fresh utterance through an unexpected speaker supplies the sequence's decisive replacement speech.

changed_reading.before: The imperative is one more ordinary proclamation to resistant listeners.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is the last authorized warning in a context where ordinary argument can be suspended, communication rerouted, and decisive truth arrive through a speaker the audience did not credit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it connects the hasr branch of shedding to the shaken palm and falling ripe fruit. It remains anchored in الْحَسْرَةِ and the focus's completion construction, with exact context images for shaking, falling, ripeness, and gathering; downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory harvest image, not identify the Day literally with the palm episode.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الْحَسْرَةِ as shedding, joined to قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ

activation_trace.role: Shedding old covering supplies the focus anchor for a terminal stripping image.
Completion gives that stripping a final rather than cyclical endpoint.
Shaking until movement supplies the activating force in the material analogy.
Falling downward supplies the separation produced by shaking.
Ripe dates supply matter that has reached readiness before it falls.
Gathering produce from its source supplies the selective aftermath of the fall.

changed_reading.before: Completion is an abstract legal or temporal ending.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, completion is a shaking and stripping that drops what has ripened into manifest result; heedlessness is therefore an unseen maturation whose harvest cannot be revised once gathered.

strongest_changes: The repeated ق ض ي + ء م ر formulas recast focus closure as enacted realization and separate decree itself from the regretful stance toward it.
19:38 makes regret the product of accurate perception arriving after completion, not endless ignorance.
The sequence from disputed truth through parties to witnessed presence makes قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ the end of contestability.
The immediate inheritance-and-return coda gives completion the concrete form of expired tenure and reversion.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly changes communicative and perceptual states: veiling becomes manifestation, warning and vow occupy different branches of one root, silence gives way to unexpected speech, dispute becomes witnessed presence, and an earlier decreed mercy becomes a final completed affair.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated decree formulas strongly activate one another, but the precise scope of الْأَمْرُ in 19:39 remains open.
The veil-to-uncovering and route-marker models depend on cross-domain transfer from concrete context images.
The vow/silence and harvest readings are branch-backed but intentionally exploratory and should not displace the stronger temporal and adjudicative models.
